title: McCarthy Tire Service — claimed by storm
description: US · Retail & E-Commerce · McCarthy Tire Service is a family-owned and operated American tire and automotive service company founded in 1926 and headquartered in Wilkes-Barre, Pennsylvania. The company specializes in commercial tire sales and services, fleet management, truck mechanical repairs, off-the-road (OTR) and industrial tires, passenger vehicle services, and 24-hour commercial roadside assistance.
